name: Scroll of wisdom: Greatness-1
description: One day, while walking home, the Magister accidentally met a young magician who asked him: Give me a powerful weapon!

name: Scroll of wisdom: Greatness-2
description: Magister picked up a branch from the ground and handed it to him. But this is an ordinary stick! - magician exclaimed with displeasure.

name: Scroll of wisdom: Greatness-3
description: Magister waved this branch and hill by road was blown away by the wind! And then magician realized that greatness is not in things, it is in ourselves.

name: Scroll of wisdom: Improvement-1
description: One day, a little pony found a tree with a golden apple growing on it, but it was hanging high, and no matter how hard he tried, he couldn't reach it.

name: Scroll of wisdom: Improvement-2
description: And at that time, Magister, who was on his way to the tavern, passed by. The pony noticed Him and began to look at him piteously.

name: Scroll of wisdom: Improvement-3
description: Then Magister stopped, picked an apple and began to eat it, saying: Don't expect anyone to help you, become stronger so you can do it yourself!

name: Scroll of wisdom: Reconciliation-1
description: Once Magister met a husband and wife on the road, who sold a cow and divided the coins equally, but could not decide who would get the last remaining coin.

name: Scroll of wisdom: Reconciliation-2
description: Magister took this coin, looked at it and said: If the power is in the truth, then the one who is strong is right!

name: Scroll of wisdom: Reconciliation-3
description: Okay, - husband replied, hitting his wife on head with all his might and taking all coins. Magister gave him a coin and walked on, smiling that he was able to resolve conflict.

name: Scroll of wisdom: Vigilance-1
description: One day Magister came across a house, next to which on a hill he saw the owner kneeling in front of a pillar. What are you doing?  - Magister asked him.

name: Scroll of wisdom: Vigilance-2
description: I pray to my gods, they will protect me and my family from any troubles and misfortunes! - that replied. Okay, - said Magister.

name: Scroll of wisdom: Vigilance-3
description: He entered owner's house, killed his parents, raped wife, children, took all valuable and returned, - Well, did your gods protect you? No? So, need to rely only on yourself!

name: Scroll of wisdom: Justice-1
description: Magister was passing through a village one day, and a young peasant woman came out of the courtyard to him.

name: Scroll of wisdom: Justice-2
description: She began to complain that all their men were taken into army, robbers constantly come to rob and rape, King takes a large tax from them, but does not protect them.

name: Scroll of wisdom: Justice-3
description: Why are we being treated so unfairly?! - she exclaimed. Magister thought about it and replied: Because you don't have a dick.

name: Scroll of wisdom: Absoluteness-1
description: One day, Magister was walking past the cemetery from a tavern, and suddenly he had a strong urge to go to the toilet.

name: Scroll of wisdom: Absoluteness-2
description: He sat down next to the grave, pulled off his underpants, and then a ghost appears in front of him and angrily says: Don't do that here!

name: Scroll of wisdom: Absoluteness-3
description: But Magister answers him: We all obey the laws of the universe, no one can resist them, neither the living nor the dead! - and continued to shit.
